text:
## Purpose  
Establish standardized procedures for setting up, maintaining, modifying, and canceling standing orders to ensure accurate, timely execution of customer-initiated recurring transfers.

raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for establishing, maintaining, modifying, and canceling standing orders on customer accounts. Ensures accurate and timely execution of customer-initiated recurring transfers through standardized operational controls.

raw_entities.name: Standing Order Setup
raw_entities.description: Initial step in which a customer-initiated standing order instruction is received and recorded in the banking system for a recurring transfer.
context: setting up, maintaining, modifying, and canceling standing orders

raw_entities.name: Standing Order Maintenance
raw_entities.description: Ongoing operational step to monitor and ensure standing orders execute correctly and on schedule according to customer instructions.
context: maintaining, modifying, and canceling standing orders

raw_entities.name: Standing Order Modification
raw_entities.description: Step to process customer-requested changes to an existing standing order, such as amount, frequency, or beneficiary details.

raw_entities.description: Step to process customer-requested termination of an existing standing order, ensuring no further recurring transfers are executed.
